id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the card list.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

compact.description: Shows the cards in compact mode (without space between the cards)

cardLimit.description: Limit the total number of principle cards in the list.

dataCollection.description: Holds the data to display in the card list.

subCardActionGroupSetting.description: Action group configuration for sub cards.

principalCardActionGroupSetting.description: Action group configuration for principal cards.

title:
A UI component type that displays data in a list of cards. It also supports the sub cards
under the top-level principal card.
name: UiSdlEnhancedCardList
